rules: When the evidence-backed research package, reasoning artifact, source index, and research limitations are ready for deck planning.
When deck production exposes a material evidence gap or unsupported claim that requires research clarification.
When the slide plan, generated slide images, and images-only PowerPoint package are ready for fidelity and readability review.
When slides need corrections to research fidelity, readability, visual quality, or prompt-output accuracy.
When the deck passes review and the coordinator needs the final package status, evidence limits, and residual risks.
